SELECT json_build_object(
    'owners', (SELECT json_agg(o) FROM owners o),
    'devices', (SELECT json_agg(d) FROM devices d),
    'analog_pins', (SELECT json_agg(a) FROM analog_pins a),
    'alerts', (SELECT json_agg(al) FROM alerts al),
    'recent_events', (SELECT json_agg(e) FROM (SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5) e)
) as dump;
